links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy compared with expert human extraction on the same reports
links.effect: The 20B model reached mean accuracy of 86.02%, beating smaller models. Error profiles were complementary: the LLM was better on syntactic consistency, humans on semantic and contextual interpretation.
links.quote: Crucially, we identified a highly complementary error profile: the LLM excelled at syntactic consistency (e.g., date/numeric formatting) where humans faltered, while human experts provided superior semantic and contextual interpretation.

unlisted_practices: Using a locally deployed on-premise LLM to structure free-text imaging reports
Testing prompt engineering to mitigate LLM semantic errors

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLMs for structured data extraction from ultrasound reports compared to human extraction and characterizes complementary error patterns to motivate human-in-the-loop workflows, but does not test a deployment practice comparatively.
